name: update_todo
description: Update fields of an existing TODO item identified by UID. Only provided fields are changed.

calendar_name.description: Name of the calendar containing the todo.

uid.description: UID of the todo to update.

priority.description: New priority from 0 (undefined) to 9 per RFC 5545, where 1 is highest (optional).

due.description: New due date as ISO 8601 (optional). A bare datetime is interpreted in the selected timezone; an offset datetime is converted to it; a date creates an all-day due. Pass null to remove the due date.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. Europe/Athens) to express the todo's dates in. Defaults to the todo's existing DUE TZID, then the configured default timezone.

status.description: New status: NEEDS-ACTION, IN-PROCESS, COMPLETED or CANCELLED (optional).
